types.label: Get a copy of my data
types.description: Receive a copy of the personal information held about you.

types.label: Delete my data
types.description: Ask for your personal information to be deleted.

types.label: Correct my data
types.description: Fix personal information that is wrong or incomplete.

types.label: Object to or restrict processing
types.description: Ask for your information to stop being used, or to be used less.

types.label: Opt out of sale or sharing
types.description: Stop your information from being sold or shared for advertising.

types.label: Withdraw consent
types.description: Take back consent you gave earlier, for example for marketing.
